Juna AI | Forward Deployed AI Engineer | Berlin | ONSITE | Full-time

Juna AI builds a Factory OS for production planning and scheduling in heavy industry: chemical plants, steel mills, paper lines. We combine AI agents with combinatorial optimization to help manufacturers figure out what to produce, when, and in what sequence. Backed by Kleiner Perkins and Norrsken VC ($7.5M seed).

As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you'll work directly with customers to understand their problems and own projects end-to-end, from sitting with plant operators to deploying AI workflows in production. We operate on the factory floor, not in slide decks.

Apply here: https://juna-ai.jobs.personio.de/job/1823357?language=en&dis...
